title: Archer hip skills: is DPC's hip-aim hold still needed with the input state fix? (DPC 0.9.177-dev6)
intro: Runs by itself on the test bench. Plays the Archer pawn (party slot 2) and fires each skill from the hip, with the input state fix and the hip-aim hold switched on and off.

probes.errs: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'dev_status/DirectPawnControl.json'); return ok and d and d.errors
probes.who: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; local s=D and D.state; local pc=s and s.active and s.pawn_chara; return pc and tostring(s.pawn_name) or 'Arisen'
probes.job: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; local s=D and D.state; local pc=s and s.active and s.pawn_chara; return pc and s.pawn_job or 0
probes.fix: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.cfg.pawn_prev_state ~= false
probes.hip: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.cfg.pawn_hip_skill_aim ~= false
probes.n0: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; local s=D and D.state; local pc=s and s.active and s.pawn_chara; return pc and H.node(pc) or ''
probes.n1: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; local s=D and D.state; local pc=s and s.active and s.pawn_chara; return pc and H.node(pc, 1) or ''
probes.sk: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; local s=D and D.state; local pc=s and s.active and s.pawn_chara; local ok,v=pcall(function() return pc:call('get_Human'):call('get_CustomSkillState') end); return ok and v or 0
probes.shot: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; local s=D and D.state; local pc=s and s.active and s.pawn_chara; if not pc then return false end; local a = tostring(H.node(pc) or '') .. ' ' .. tostring(H.node(pc, 1) or ''); return (a:find('Shoot', 1, true) or a:find('Shot', 1, true) and not a:find('Prepare', 1, true) and not a:find('Ready', 1, true)) and true or false
probes.cancel: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; local s=D and D.state; local pc=s and s.active and s.pawn_chara; if not pc then return false end; local a = tostring(H.node(pc) or '') .. ' ' .. tostring(H.node(pc, 1) or ''); return a:find('Cancel', 1, true) and true or false
